assessments.reasoning: The abstract explicitly presents Data General’s language as ALGOL 60 with extensions. The usage guide instructs readers familiar with ALGOL to consult the additional material on those extensions.

challenge.method: Compare early document 093-000052-00 with the later revision and the distinct compiler design notes.
challenge.results: The early publication directly supports the stated extension relation. The later edition and implementation notes cannot establish strict semantic acceptance of every ALGOL 60 program by the early compiler.

limitations: The finding reports the publisher’s documentary relation and makes no tested compatibility or execution claim.
